PROCEEDINGS OF THE GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
Sub: Regarding authorization of Government Advocate, Hon'ble High Court of
Karnataka, Bengaluru Bench, Bengaluru to appear and oppose the W.P.No.
18329/2025 filed by Dr.Prasanna Kumar S/o Late Halappa V/S The State
of Karnataka & others on the file of the 1100016. High Court of Karnataka,
Bengaluru Bench, Bengaluru.
GOVERNMENT ORDER NO:ED 02 UTT 2025
BENGALURU, DATED:07.07.2025
With reference to the file No. ED 02 UTT 2025 received from the Deputy Secretary
to Government, Department of Higher Education, M.S.Building, Bengaluru-560001 on the
subject mentioned above, the Government Advocate, Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka,
Bengaluru Bench, Bengaluru is authorized to appear and oppose the W.P.No. 18329/2025 filed
by Dr.Prasanna Kumar S/o Late Halappa V/S The State of Karnataka & others on the
Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka, Bengaluru Bench, Bengaluru on behalf of the following
Respondent.

1) The State of Karnataka, Represented by its Principal Secretary, Department
of Higher Education Department, M.S_ Building, Dr.Ambedkar Road,
Bengaluru-560001.

The Under Secretary to Government, Higher Education (University-2) Department
of Collegiate Education, Palace Road, Bengaluru-560001 (Phone No.080-22032538 and
Email Id: usuniversitysection2@gmail.com) shall be the Litigation Conducting Officer and
Swearing Officer. The Litigation Conducting Officer shall follow up the case and intimate
about the Judgement/ Order, if any. He is directed to furnish all particulars, parawise remarks and
records required in this behalf for preparing draft statement to the Government Advocate, Hon'ble
High Court of Karnataka, Bengaluru Bench, Bengaluru. The Government Advocate, Hon'ble
High Court of Karnataka, Bengaluru Bench, Bengaluru shall verify the Stay Order, if any and
prepare necessary application to vacate the Stay Order.

BY ORDER AND IN THE NAME OF THE
GOVERNOR OF KARNATAKA
(FAIROZA H. UKKALI)
Head of Legal Cell & Ex-officio Deputy
Secretary to Government, Department of Higher
gin. Health & Family Welfare & Medical Edn.

Dr.B.R.Ambedkar Veedhi, Bengaluru-560001.
